title: I made a full 4X in about a week with Claude Code and ChatGPT images.
author: Altriz
selftext:
Tiny Gods is a turn-based fantasy 4X where every battle is an autobattle: you set a 3×3 formation and watch. It has six kingdoms, heroes that change form, diplomacy, and online multiplayer with simultaneous turns. It's free on itch.

How it was made:

* **Code:** Godot 4.7.2 + GDScript, all of it written by Claude Code. I acted like a lead designer: I wrote what I wanted, it built it, I played, I complained, it fixed. 
* **Art:** ChatGPT image generation from one prompt pack, so every unit and hero shares the same style header. For hero evolutions I fed the base portrait back in as a reference. 
* **Music:** MIDI scores rendered with a soundfont, not Suno. I wanted loops I could edit note by note.
* **Testing:** this was the part that saved me. Headless test suites, and AI-vs-AI matches running in the background to catch stalls and balance problems. 

 Game: [https://altriz.itch.io/tiny-gods](https://altriz.itch.io/tiny-gods) · Trailer: [https://youtu.be/JLsRGmgblAE](https://youtu.be/JLsRGmgblAE)
